title: rust-bench/v1
description: RESEARCH-ONLY. One run of the Rust performance benchmarks of tools/research/mcp-rhai (benches/hot_paths.rs), as tools/research/rust-bench run writes it to research/results/bench-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS>-<rev8>.json from criterion's estimates. Times are nanoseconds per iteration. See research/rust-bench.md.

id.description: bench-<UTC time of the run>-<first 8 hex digits of rev>; the record's file name without .json

generated_at.description: when the run ended, UTC, ISO 8601

rev.description: git HEAD the benchmarks were built from

tree_dirty.description: an input of the benches had uncommitted changes (tracked or untracked, not ignored) when they were built: the crate, its path dependencies tools/research/real-world and tools/research/vendor/algoglyph, tools/research/mcp-panel/rhai or tools/research/schema/fixtures

host.description: the machine the run measured; a check compares only records of the same name, os and cpus

name.description: the host's short name (--host or RUST_BENCH_HOST, else the first label of its hostname)

os.description: macos, linux, windows, or the platform's own lowercased name

median.description: criterion's median estimate per iteration; what check compares

throughput.description: what one iteration processes, when the bench declares it (criterion Throughput); null otherwise

baseline.description: the newest committed record of the same host this run was compared with, and every bench whose median grew by more than the run's threshold (default 25 %) and lies above that record's slowest sample; a record with regressions is written only with run --accept
